note: The MEASURED road surface of Assetto Corsa's ks_brands_hatch / indy, taken from a real captured lap (first rig session, 2026-08-05). Per sample: x/y/z is the centroid of the four tyre contact patches -- a point ON the road, at cm precision -- and nx/ny/nz is the mean of the four measured contact normals. ax/ay/az is the front axle's contact-patch separation vector (FR minus FL), which measures the cross-slope directly, without reference to any normal. Frame is the canonical one: +x right, +z down seen from above, +y up. Every third sample of a 30 Hz lap, i.e. roughly 2.5 m apart.
source: cp*/cn* channels of a real uploaded lap
